meta.title: Aura Farm
meta.instructions: Tap anywhere when the spark hits the glowing zone. Perfect taps stack your combo and aura. Tap early: -500 aura. Let the spark slip past the zone: -1000 aura and a pair of shades cracks. Survive 45 seconds and rank up.

arc.body: concat(map(range(9), i => let a = ang(c - w + w * i / 4.0) in vec(cos(a) * r1, sin(a) * r1)), map(range(9), i => let a = ang(c + w - w * i / 4.0) in vec(cos(a) * r0, sin(a) * r0)))

pop_color.body: if pop_kind == 0 then '#FFD23F' else if pop_kind == 1 then '#B6FF3B' else '#FF3D7F'

node.w: = if rank >= 7 then 140.0 else 140.0 * clamp((aura - (if rank == 0 then 0 else next_at(rank - 1))) * 1.0 / ((next_at(rank) - (if rank == 0 then 0 else next_at(rank - 1))) * 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)

node.frame: = if now - pop_at < 550 then (if pop_kind == 2 then 2 else 1) else 0

node.text: = if now < 6000 then 'TAP WHEN THE SPARK HITS THE GLOW' else if rank >= 7 then 'MAXIMUM AURA. TOUCH GRASS?' else 'next rank at ' + str(next_at(rank)) + ' aura'

children.text: = if status == 'won' then 'AURA ASCENDED' else 'SHADES SHATTERED'
= get_or(content_end_lines, rank, 'You are the aura now.') + ' Best combo x' + str(best_combo + 1) + '.'

art.style: Synthwave aura shrine: purple sunburst, magenta grid floor, a smug lime bean in shades and a gold chain, a golden spark orbiting a glow ring.
